text: The earth grid shall meet the tolerable touch and step voltages of IEEE 80 for a 70 kg person and shall keep the ground potential rise transferred to remote earths (telecommunication, fence, pipes) below the tolerable levels; the grid resistance shall be 0.5 ohm or less (target) and the actual value shall come from the earthing study (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-STU-0003).
